# `tag-added`

Tag added

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `docs` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `tag-added` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Docs (annotations only) ([RULES.md section 10](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A tag was added to the top-level `tags` list.

## Why this default

Documentation only.

## Example

From test case [`tag-added`](../../test/cases/tag-added/): A tag was added to the top-level tags list.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
  tags:
  - name: pets
+ - name: owners
  paths:
    '/pets':
```

Findings:

- `tag-added` · info · document

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.
